# statusdrift_on_call_policies (Data Source)

Fetches all on-call policies.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "statusdrift_on_call_policies" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder ID for Terraform state.
- `on_call_policies` (Attributes List) List of on-call policies. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--on_call_policies))

<a id="nestedatt--on_call_policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `on_call_policies`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the policy is active.
- `id` (Number) The ID of the on-call policy.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default policy.
- `name` (String) The name of the on-call policy.
- `scope_type` (String) Policy scope type.
